description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different conditions. The x-axis represents Training Time, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000 seconds, and tick labels are spaced every 50000 seconds. The y-axis represents Loss, with a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels are spaced every 0.05. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla” and marked with triangle markers, begins at approximately 2.72 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.52 at a training time of 250000 seconds, with a plateau between 150000 and 200000 seconds where the loss remains around 2.53. A red line, marked with circle markers, starts at approximately 2.68 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to approximately 2.51 at a training time of 250000 seconds, with a plateau between 150000 and 200000 seconds where the loss remains around 2.52. A green dashed line is present at a loss value of 2.50.
